name: Samuel Barras
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Samuel Barras is represented here by verse printed in John Bell's Rhymes of Northern Bards (Newcastle, 1812), 1 piece.
Bell's book gives no dates for this writer, so the date above is the year of the collection in which the verse appears. The dialect spelling of the printed texts is kept.

poems.title: Epitaph on William Bell
poems.author: Samuel Barras
poems.text:
Here lies the corpse of William Bell,
The great good man of Gateshead Fell:
Zealous in his Master’s cause,
A strict observer of his laws:
He liv’d by faith, and not by sight:
With full assurance took his flight,
Unto that sweet delicious coast,
Where hope is in fruition lost.
